godot_doom_gdextension.subject:
Let go of the stick when the HUD leaves, and put the engine back on E1M1 after a level change

PureDoomControls drives a synthetic joypad axis for a thumb on the stick; freed with the thumb still
down, the last value it sent stood in Godot's joypad state and whatever read that pad next, the
Player in the scene it hands over to, walked off on its own. It now centres every axis it drove
and releases a held weapon key on the way out of the tree. The level-changing engine test warps
back to E1M1, since the engine is one per process and every later node inherits its level.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
